items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Harrison? Harrison you think? Yeah, I think it was Harrison. I'm trying to think of the guy that used to be with him.

ctx.x: Harrison? Harrison you think? Yeah, I think it was Harrison. I'm trying to think of the guy that used to be with him.
He had pills and he had George Lewis and he had Mealy Barnes. Ask him was it pills or Mealy Barnes or George Lewis or who?
